mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 12-month average indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% in the most recent month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% in the most recent month, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative sentiment shift in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), which signal a contraction in the manufacturing sector, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced corporate profits, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to its 12-month average signals strong consumer confidence and robust demand for housing, which correlates with positive equity market sentiment and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST is above 110 in the most recent month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in the prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 qoq > 2.0%), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive forward returns due to robust corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 qoq exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
